AI and automation · 2026

Clara, the Gibcom inbound line

An AI voice assistant that answers enquiries, qualifies them and books callbacks.

Status
In development
My role
Conversation design, call flow and integration with the enquiry process

Talk to me about this

Overview

Clara answers Gibcom's inbound line. She greets callers, works out what they need, captures the details and books a callback, so a small team never misses an enquiry while on client work.

The problem

Enquiries arrived while the team was with clients. Voicemail went unanswered for hours and some callers never left a message.

Approach

  • Wrote the conversation as a script first, then built the flow around it.
  • Kept Clara to qualifying and booking; anything complex is handed to a person.
  • Integrated the captured details with the existing enquiry process rather than creating a new inbox.

Tools

  • AI voice assistant platform
  • Conversation design
  • Call-flow automation

Outcomes and next measurement

Clara is not measured yet. Once she is answering the Gibcom phone line, the first measures will be calls answered, enquiries captured and callbacks booked, compared with the voicemail period before.

What I learned

A voice assistant is a script before it is a system. Getting the words right for a nervous caller mattered more than any setting.
